newsitem.title: USA: Chase expects $510 mln merger savings in 96. [CORRECTED 20:48 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Chase expects $510 mln merger savings in 96. [CORRECTED 20:48 GMT]

text.p: Chase Manhattan Corp said Tuesday it realized $180 million in savings during the third quarter from its merger into Chemical Banking Corp. It said it expects to realize $510 million in savings from the merger in 1996.
(Corrects to total savings of $510 million instead of an additional $510 million in savings).
Net charge-offs for the quarter were $220 million, compared with $225 million in the same period in 1995, the company said as it released its earnings for the quarter.
Of the $210 million in charge-offs, credit card charge-offs accounted for $152 million, it said.
